I give up. I did not attempt a compile, since the file as given would only show the existing `sorry`.

The statement is true: the Putnam 2015 B6 answer is π²/16. But a Lean proof would need a full formalization of that argument, which I don't think I can complete here. The argument rewrites the sum by writing k = j·m with j odd, using j < √(2k) ⇔ j < 2m. That turns it into a conditionally convergent double series over odd j and m > j/2. Proving the limit then requires a rearrangement argument for that series, plus tail estimates to handle the non-absolute convergence. Doing that in Lean 4 with only compiled Mathlib available, and with no ability to test lemma names beyond compiling scratch files, is far beyond what I can reliably finish.
